name: SKAN conversion values (fine and coarse)
plain: A 6-bit number the app sets after install so the ad network learns how valuable the user was.
meaning: Encodes early behavior (purchase, level) into at most 64 values, which is the only per-campaign performance signal left for non-consenting iOS users.

android.note: No equivalent: Android attribution carries identifiers and arbitrary events.

ios.note: Fine value is only returned in the first postback and only at the highest crowd tier; later postbacks carry coarse low, medium or high.

data.metric: Fine value 0 to 63 (6 bits), coarse 3 levels
data.update: can be updated until the window locks or closes

fields.name: lockWindow
fields.range: true ends the window early so the postback can send sooner

limits.headline: Can send the ad network a small score about what you did after install
limits.user_action: You use the app, for example buy something or reach a level
can: Set a number from 0 to 63 that sums up early behavior
Send a detailed score in the first report, when enough people installed
Send a coarse low, medium or high score in later reports
cannot: Send a detailed score when too few installs came from the campaign
Work on Android; it sends events and IDs instead
limits.differs: iPhone only (iOS 14 and later). Android attribution can carry IDs and many events.

story.what_it_is: A tiny number the app sets after install, so the ad network learns how valuable the new user is.

marketing.name: Conversion values
marketing.pitch: A short value an app updates after install, to report coarse in app results to the ad network.

story.for_you: You just play the app. Without your knowing, early actions such as a first purchase or level 5 bump a tiny number that is later sent to the ad network.
story.for_makers: It holds at most 64 values, so makers must pick what matters most: first purchase, level or sign up. It is the only per campaign performance signal left for people who say no to tracking.

use_cases.example: A studio sets the value to 'finished tutorial and bought a $5 pack' so ad networks can find more payers.
A retail app sets a higher value for people who add to cart on day one.
A workout app marks 'subscribed after trial' so networks learn who pays.
An ad network uses the value to bid more for campaigns that bring higher quality users.
A growth team tests different value maps and checks which predicts revenue.
A fintech app marks 'funded account' so the network learns which ads bring real customers.

risks: Reveals how you behave in aggregate
story.android_note: Android has no equal tool. Apps send full events with the advertising ID.
story.ios_note: SKAN 4 adds fine and coarse values with different privacy tiers.

technical_bounds: Fine value only at crowd tier 3
Only one fine value across 3 windows (first postback)
MMP conversion studios map events to values

abuse: Hiding fingerprint-like bits in the value

history.change: Coarse values and lockWindow added in SKAN 4
